constraints: No deep knee bending — stay well above parallel
No jumping or quick direction changes
Seated or supported options are always fine
Nothing should ever hurt — mild effort is enough
goals: Stronger legs for stairs and getting out of chairs
Better balance — steady on your feet
Keep shoulders, back and grip strong

weeks.label: Week 1 — Getting started
weeks.note: This week is about learning the movements, not working hard. Every set should feel easy — like you could do 3 or 4 more. If anything hurts, skip it and tell Shea.

days.name: Session A — Legs & Balance
warmup: 5 minutes easy pedalling on the bike (light resistance, seat high)
10 gentle marches on the spot, holding the kitchen bench
5 slow ankle circles each way, each foot

exercises.name: Sit-to-Stand from a High Chair
exercises.cue: Sit tall, lean forward a little, push through your heels to stand
exercises.alternative: Use the armrests to help yourself up
exercises.stopIf: Sharp pain in the knee, or the knee feels like it might give way — stop and skip this one

exercises.name: Small Squat Holding the Bench
exercises.cue: Bend the knees just a little — thighs stay well above level. Hold the bench the whole time
exercises.alternative: Make the bend even smaller — a few centimetres is fine
exercises.stopIf: Any knee pain at all — make the bend smaller or stop

exercises.name: Heel Raises Holding the Bench
exercises.cue: Rise up onto your toes slowly, lower down even slower
exercises.alternative: Rise up with both feet, hold the bench firmly
exercises.stopIf: Cramping or sharp calf pain — stop and stretch gently

exercises.name: Side Leg Raises at the Bench
exercises.cue: Stand tall, lift the leg out to the side — small lift, no leaning
exercises.alternative: Smaller lift, or just shift your weight side to side
exercises.stopIf: Hip or knee pain — stop

exercises.name: Slow Marching with a Pause
exercises.cue: Lift one knee, pause for a second, place it down gently. Fingertips on the bench
exercises.alternative: Hold the bench with your whole hand
exercises.stopIf: Feeling unsteady or dizzy — sit down and rest

exercises.name: Balance Practice — Feet in a Line
exercises.cue: One foot in front of the other like a tightrope, next to the bench. Eyes up
exercises.alternative: Feet slightly apart instead of in a line
exercises.stopIf: Any wobble you can't control — grab the bench, that's what it's there for

cooldown: 3 minutes easy walking around the house
Gentle calf stretch at the wall, 30 seconds each leg — no bouncing

days.name: Session B — Push, Pull & Grip
warmup: 5 minutes easy pedalling on the bike

exercises.name: One-Arm Row, Hand on the Bench
exercises.cue: Lean on the bench with one hand, pull the weight to your hip
exercises.alternative: Sit on a chair and do it one arm at a time, elbow to your side
exercises.stopIf: Lower back pain — sit down for the seated version instead

exercises.name: Push-Up Against the Bench
exercises.cue: Hands on the bench, body in a straight line, lower slowly
exercises.alternative: Stand closer to the bench, or push against the wall instead
exercises.stopIf: Wrist or shoulder pain — switch to the wall version

exercises.name: Seated Shoulder Press
exercises.cue: Sit tall against the chair back, press up smoothly, don't lock the elbows hard
exercises.alternative: One arm at a time, or press only to eye level
exercises.stopIf: Shoulder pinching — lower the weight or press only part way up

exercises.name: Standing Curl
exercises.cue: Elbows by your sides, curl up slowly, lower even slower
exercises.alternative: Sit down and do one arm at a time
exercises.stopIf: Elbow pain — go lighter

exercises.name: Farmer Hold — Stand Still and Grip
exercises.cue: Stand tall, shoulders back, squeeze the handles hard
exercises.alternative: Hold one dumbbell with both hands in front of you
exercises.stopIf: Feeling unsteady — put them down, hold the bench, rest

exercises.name: Easy Bike Spin
exercises.load: Light — you should be able to chat the whole time
exercises.cue: Comfortable pace, seat high enough that the knee never bends sharply
exercises.stopIf: Knee discomfort — raise the seat or ease the resistance

cooldown: Gentle chest stretch in a doorway, 30 seconds
Shake the arms out, roll the shoulders

days.name: Session C — Move & Carry
warmup: 5 minutes easy walking or easy bike

exercises.name: Sit-to-Stand from a High Chair
exercises.cue: Same as Session A — sit tall, push through your heels
exercises.stopIf: Sharp knee pain — stop and skip

exercises.name: Hip Bridge Lying Down
exercises.cue: Lie on your back, knees bent gently, lift your hips and squeeze your bottom at the top
exercises.alternative: Smaller lift — even a few centimetres counts
exercises.stopIf: Back or knee pain — stop

exercises.name: Heel Taps on a Low Step
exercises.cue: Stand on the floor holding the rail, tap one heel onto a low step and back. No stepping up yet
exercises.alternative: Tap the heel on the flat floor in front of you instead
exercises.stopIf: Any knee pain — do the flat-floor version

exercises.name: Suitcase Carry
exercises.cue: Carry it like a suitcase — walk tall, don't lean towards the weight
exercises.stopIf: Feeling unsteady — put it down and walk without it

exercises.name: Standing Knee Lift & Reach
exercises.cue: Hold the bench, lift one knee gently while reaching forward with the other arm
exercises.alternative: Just the knee lift, no reach
exercises.stopIf: Unsteady or dizzy — sit and rest

exercises.name: Heel-to-Toe Walk Along the Bench
exercises.cue: Walk in a line, one foot placed just in front of the other, fingers tracing the bench
exercises.alternative: Normal small steps along the bench
exercises.stopIf: Wobbling — hold the bench firmly, take a break

exercises.name: Easy Walk or Bike
exercises.cue: Finish with easy movement. Outside if the weather's good
exercises.stopIf: Knee discomfort when walking — switch to the bike

cooldown: Gentle calf and thigh stretch holding the bench, 30 seconds each
Three slow deep breaths — done!

weeks.label: Week 2 — Finding the rhythm
weeks.note: Same movements as last week with a couple of extra repeats. Still easy — you should finish every set feeling like you had more in you.

days.name: Session A — Legs & Balance
warmup: 5 minutes easy pedalling on the bike

exercises.name: Sit-to-Stand from a High Chair
exercises.cue: Two more than last week. Sit tall, push through your heels
exercises.alternative: Use the armrests for the last couple
exercises.stopIf: Sharp knee pain — stop and skip

exercises.name: Small Squat Holding the Bench
exercises.cue: Same small bend as last week — don't go deeper, just do a couple more
exercises.stopIf: Any knee pain — smaller bend or stop

exercises.name: Heel Raises Holding the Bench
exercises.cue: Slow up, slower down
exercises.alternative: Both feet, firm grip on the bench
exercises.stopIf: Calf cramp — stop and stretch

exercises.name: Side Leg Raises at the Bench
exercises.cue: Stand tall, small controlled lift
exercises.stopIf: Hip or knee pain — stop

exercises.name: Slow Marching with a Pause
exercises.cue: Try a longer pause at the top of each lift — one full second
exercises.stopIf: Unsteady or dizzy — sit down

exercises.name: Balance Practice — Feet in a Line
exercises.cue: A little longer than last week. Eyes on a spot on the wall
exercises.stopIf: Uncontrolled wobble — grab the bench

cooldown: 3 minutes easy walking
Calf stretch at the wall, 30 seconds each leg

days.name: Session B — Push, Pull & Grip
warmup: 5 minutes easy pedalling on the bike

exercises.name: One-Arm Row, Hand on the Bench
exercises.cue: Two extra each side. Pull to the hip, squeeze the shoulder blade
exercises.stopIf: Lower back pain — sit down for it

exercises.name: Push-Up Against the Bench
exercises.cue: Straight line from head to heels, lower slowly
exercises.stopIf: Wrist or shoulder pain — wall version

exercises.name: Seated Shoulder Press
exercises.cue: Sit tall, smooth press, soft elbows at the top
exercises.stopIf: Shoulder pinching — lighter or part way up

exercises.name: Standing Curl
exercises.cue: Elbows glued to your sides
exercises.alternative: Seated, one arm at a time
exercises.stopIf: Elbow pain — go lighter

exercises.name: Farmer Hold — Stand Still and Grip
exercises.cue: Five seconds longer. Tall posture, hard grip
exercises.stopIf: Unsteady — put them down

exercises.name: Easy Bike Spin
exercises.cue: Two minutes longer than last week
exercises.stopIf: Knee discomfort — raise the seat or ease off

cooldown: Doorway chest stretch, 30 seconds
Shoulder rolls

days.name: Session C — Move & Carry

exercises.name: Sit-to-Stand from a High Chair
exercises.cue: Push through the heels, stand fully tall at the top
exercises.stopIf: Sharp knee pain — stop

exercises.name: Hip Bridge Lying Down
exercises.cue: Squeeze at the top for a second before lowering
exercises.stopIf: Back or knee pain — stop

exercises.name: Heel Taps on a Low Step
exercises.cue: Gentle tap, all your weight stays on the standing leg — hold the rail
exercises.stopIf: Any knee pain — flat-floor version

exercises.name: Suitcase Carry
exercises.cue: Walk tall — imagine a book balanced on your head
exercises.stopIf: Unsteady — put it down

exercises.name: Standing Knee Lift & Reach
exercises.cue: Smooth and slow, light fingertips on the bench
exercises.stopIf: Unsteady or dizzy — sit and rest

exercises.name: Heel-to-Toe Walk Along the Bench
exercises.cue: Slightly longer walk. Head up, eyes forward
exercises.stopIf: Wobbling — hold on and rest

exercises.name: Easy Walk or Bike
exercises.cue: Comfortable finish
exercises.stopIf: Knee discomfort walking — use the bike

cooldown: Calf and thigh stretch holding the bench, 30 seconds each
Three slow deep breaths

weeks.label: Week 3 — A third set
weeks.note: This week the main exercises get a third set. Reps drop back down, so each set is short. Take the full rest between sets — no rushing.

days.name: Session A — Legs & Balance
warmup: 5 minutes easy pedalling on the bike

exercises.name: Sit-to-Stand from a High Chair
exercises.cue: Three sets now, but only 6 each — plenty of rest between
exercises.alternative: Armrests on the third set if needed
exercises.stopIf: Sharp knee pain — stop and skip

exercises.name: Small Squat Holding the Bench
exercises.cue: Same comfortable depth — the third set is the only change
exercises.alternative: Tiny bend is still a rep
exercises.stopIf: Any knee pain — smaller or stop

exercises.name: Heel Raises Holding the Bench
exercises.cue: Try pausing for a second right at the top
exercises.stopIf: Calf cramp — stop and stretch

exercises.name: Side Leg Raises at the Bench
exercises.cue: Control it on the way down too
exercises.stopIf: Hip or knee pain — stop

exercises.name: Slow Marching with a Pause
exercises.cue: Can you do a few steps with just one fingertip on the bench?
exercises.stopIf: Unsteady or dizzy — sit down

exercises.name: Balance Practice — Feet in a Line
exercises.cue: Half a minute now. Breathe normally — don't hold your breath
exercises.stopIf: Uncontrolled wobble — grab the bench

cooldown: 3 minutes easy walking
Calf stretch at the wall, 30 seconds each leg

days.name: Session B — Push, Pull & Grip
warmup: 5 minutes easy pedalling on the bike

exercises.name: One-Arm Row, Hand on the Bench
exercises.load: Same dumbbell — or one size up if the last week felt easy
exercises.cue: Third set added. Smooth pull, no jerking
exercises.stopIf: Lower back pain — seated version

exercises.name: Push-Up Against the Bench
exercises.cue: Three short sets beats two long ones. Slow lowering
exercises.stopIf: Wrist or shoulder pain — wall version

exercises.name: Seated Shoulder Press
exercises.cue: Back stays against the chair the whole set
exercises.stopIf: Shoulder pinching — lighter or part way

exercises.name: Standing Curl
exercises.cue: Slow lower — count three seconds down
exercises.stopIf: Elbow pain — lighter

exercises.name: Farmer Hold — Stand Still and Grip
exercises.cue: Three holds now. Stand like a soldier
exercises.stopIf: Unsteady — put them down

exercises.name: Easy Bike Spin
exercises.cue: Steady and comfortable
exercises.stopIf: Knee discomfort — adjust the seat or ease off

cooldown: Doorway chest stretch, 30 seconds
Shoulder rolls

days.name: Session C — Move & Carry

exercises.name: Sit-to-Stand from a High Chair
exercises.cue: Third set added — this is the most important exercise in the whole program
exercises.stopIf: Sharp knee pain — stop

exercises.name: Hip Bridge Lying Down
exercises.cue: Squeeze and hold one second at the top
exercises.stopIf: Back or knee pain — stop

exercises.name: Heel Taps on a Low Step
exercises.cue: Still just a tap — no weight goes onto the stepping foot
exercises.stopIf: Any knee pain — flat-floor version

exercises.name: Suitcase Carry
exercises.load: Same dumbbell — or one size up if easy
exercises.cue: Three carries. Tall and steady beats fast
exercises.stopIf: Unsteady — put it down

exercises.name: Standing Knee Lift & Reach
exercises.cue: Try one or two with just fingertips touching
exercises.stopIf: Unsteady or dizzy — sit and rest

exercises.name: Heel-to-Toe Walk Along the Bench
exercises.cue: Smooth, unhurried steps
exercises.stopIf: Wobbling — hold on

exercises.name: Easy Walk or Bike
exercises.cue: A couple of minutes longer this week
exercises.stopIf: Knee discomfort walking — use the bike

cooldown: Calf and thigh stretch holding the bench, 30 seconds each
Three slow deep breaths

weeks.label: Week 4 — Steady and confident
weeks.note: Last week of the block. Nothing new — just doing the week 3 work a little more smoothly. Notice how much easier the first week's numbers would feel now. Tell Shea how each session felt so he can build the next block.

days.name: Session A — Legs & Balance
warmup: 5 minutes easy pedalling on the bike

exercises.name: Sit-to-Stand from a High Chair
exercises.cue: If this feels controlled, try the last set from a slightly lower chair
exercises.alternative: Stay with the high chair — no rush
exercises.stopIf: Sharp knee pain — stop and skip

exercises.name: Small Squat Holding the Bench
exercises.cue: Same depth as always. Smooth as clockwork
exercises.stopIf: Any knee pain — smaller or stop

exercises.name: Heel Raises Holding the Bench
exercises.cue: Pause at the top, three seconds down
exercises.stopIf: Calf cramp — stop and stretch

exercises.name: Side Leg Raises at the Bench
exercises.cue: Tall posture, controlled both ways
exercises.stopIf: Hip or knee pain — stop

exercises.name: Slow Marching with a Pause
exercises.cue: How many steps can you do with fingertips only?
exercises.stopIf: Unsteady or dizzy — sit down

exercises.name: Balance Practice — Feet in a Line
exercises.cue: Try one round with the front foot swapped
exercises.stopIf: Uncontrolled wobble — grab the bench

cooldown: 3 minutes easy walking
Calf stretch at the wall, 30 seconds each leg

days.name: Session B — Push, Pull & Grip
warmup: 5 minutes easy pedalling on the bike

exercises.name: One-Arm Row, Hand on the Bench
exercises.load: Whatever weight felt right in week 3
exercises.cue: Strong, smooth pulls — you've earned these
exercises.stopIf: Lower back pain — seated version

exercises.name: Push-Up Against the Bench
exercises.cue: Chest towards the bench, slow and proud
exercises.stopIf: Wrist or shoulder pain — wall version

exercises.name: Seated Shoulder Press
exercises.cue: Sit tall — imagine growing an inch as you press
exercises.stopIf: Shoulder pinching — lighter or part way

exercises.name: Standing Curl
exercises.cue: Third set added. Slow lower every rep
exercises.stopIf: Elbow pain — lighter

exercises.name: Farmer Hold — Stand Still and Grip
exercises.cue: Half a minute of soldier-straight standing. Great for grip and posture
exercises.stopIf: Unsteady — put them down

exercises.name: Easy Bike Spin
exercises.cue: Finish feeling better than you started
exercises.stopIf: Knee discomfort — adjust or ease off

cooldown: Doorway chest stretch, 30 seconds
Shoulder rolls

days.name: Session C — Move & Carry

exercises.name: Sit-to-Stand from a High Chair
exercises.cue: Last session of the block — make these the best ones yet
exercises.stopIf: Sharp knee pain — stop

exercises.name: Hip Bridge Lying Down
exercises.cue: Squeeze at the top, lower with control
exercises.stopIf: Back or knee pain — stop

exercises.name: Heel Taps on a Low Step
exercises.cue: Still just taps. If these have been pain-free all month, tell Shea — real step-ups might come next block
exercises.stopIf: Any knee pain — flat-floor version

exercises.name: Suitcase Carry
exercises.cue: Tall, steady, strong grip
exercises.stopIf: Unsteady — put it down

exercises.name: Standing Knee Lift & Reach
exercises.cue: Smooth and confident
exercises.stopIf: Unsteady or dizzy — sit and rest

exercises.name: Heel-to-Toe Walk Along the Bench
exercises.cue: Longest walk of the block. Look how far balance has come in a month
exercises.stopIf: Wobbling — hold on

exercises.name: Easy Walk or Bike
exercises.cue: Block done. Well earned
exercises.stopIf: Knee discomfort walking — use the bike

cooldown: Calf and thigh stretch holding the bench, 30 seconds each
Three slow deep breaths — that's the block finished!
